title: Call and He Will Answer
old_p1: The king did not like Jeremiah’s messages, so his guards kept Jeremiah shut in a courtyard. A courtyard is an open yard with walls all around. Jeremiah could not go out.
But Heavenly Father’s words can go anywhere, even over walls. A message came to Jeremiah right there: “Call unto me, and I will answer thee.”
old_p2: To call means to talk to Heavenly Father, like we do when we pray. He promised He would answer.
“I will shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not,” He said. Shew is an old way to say show. He would show Jeremiah wonderful things he did not know yet.
You can pray from right where you are, even snuggled in your bed. Fold your arms tonight and feel how close He is.
p1: The prophet Jeremiah shared Heavenly Father’s words. The king did not like those words. So the king shut Jeremiah inside the prison yard. A prison yard has walls all around, and you cannot leave.
Jeremiah could not go home. He could not walk out the gate. But Heavenly Father can reach us anywhere, even behind walls.
Heavenly Father spoke to Jeremiah right there in the prison yard. He said, “Call to me, and I will answer you.”
p2: To call to Heavenly Father means to pray. He promised to answer Jeremiah. He also promised to show him great things Jeremiah did not know yet.
You can call to Heavenly Father too, from anywhere at all. Tonight, fold your arms and tell Him about your day. He hears you, and He will answer.
